units.source_text: 冬天来临的时候，我临时有事必须回老家一趟。

en.t: When winter came, something unexpected made it necessary for me to go back to my hometown for a while.

units.source_text: 母亲在来信中写了父亲病情的发展，似乎不太乐观，

en.t: In her letter, my mother wrote about the course of my father's illness, and it did not seem very encouraging,

units.source_text: 最后附上了一句：虽然眼下还过得去，但毕竟上了年纪，

en.t: and at the end she added one line: although he is managing for now, he is getting old after all,

units.source_text: 你尽可能抽时间回来看看。

en.t: so please find time to come home and see him if you possibly can.

units.source_text: 父亲很早就患了肾病，就是中年人常患的那种慢性病。

en.t: My father had suffered from kidney disease for a long time; it was the sort of chronic illness often seen in middle-aged people.

units.source_text: 不过，父亲和家里人都相信，只要小心调理，就不会突然加重。

en.t: Still, both my father and everyone in the family believed that as long as he took proper care of himself, it would not suddenly grow worse.

units.source_text: 所以一有客人来访，父亲就向客人夸口说，幸亏他懂得些养生之道，才对付到了今天。

en.t: So whenever visitors came, my father would boast to them that thanks to his knowledge of how to preserve his health, he had managed to get by until now.

units.source_text: 据母亲信中说，父亲到院子里去干活的时候，突然晕倒了。

en.t: According to my mother's letter, my father had gone out into the yard to do some work when he suddenly fainted.

units.source_text: 家里人误以为是轻微的脑溢血，马上进行了抢救。

en.t: The family mistakenly thought it was a mild cerebral hemorrhage and immediately gave him emergency treatment.

units.source_text: 后来经医生诊断，并不是因为脑溢血，还是肾病的缘故，大家这才把晕倒和肾病联系了起来。

en.t: Later, after the doctor's diagnosis showed that it was not due to a cerebral hemorrhage but to his kidney disease, everyone finally connected the fainting spell with that illness.

units.source_text: 离寒假还有一段时间，我本想学期末再回去也无妨，便拖了一两天，

en.t: There was still some time before winter vacation, and I thought it would be all right to wait until the end of the term before going back, so I delayed for a day or two,

units.source_text: 可是这一两天来，父亲卧床不起的样子、母亲忧虑的面容时时浮现在眼前。

en.t: but during those one or two days, the image of my father lying helpless in bed and my mother's worried face kept appearing before my eyes.

units.source_text: 每当此时，我就感到心里不安，便下决心回家。

en.t: Each time that happened, I felt uneasy, and I made up my mind to go home.

units.source_text: 为了省去家里寄路费的手续和时间，我到先生家去告别的时候，

en.t: To save my family the trouble and time of sending me travel expenses, when I went to Sensei's house to say goodbye,

units.source_text: 顺便请先生为我垫付一下所需的钱。

en.t: I also asked him to advance me the money I needed.
